Remi Roofing, did an excellent job on the roof and replacement of the 38 solar panels. The entire job exceeded our expectations. Remi Roofing has exceptional communication, and kept us informed as work progressed. They cleaned up all around the house and made sure everything was in perfect working order. We could not be happier with outcome and Remi Roofing.
Too many careless errors. The biggest headache was Remi's failure to get a permit from the City of Rock Springs.

Weaver construction did an excellent job. However, the City of Rock Springs would not inspect the work due to the lack of a permit. It took Remi months to send an inspector out of Salt Lake. The inspector said it looked good, but he couldn't give me a copy of it because I hadn't paid him.
I am happy with the new shingles. However, at 79. I don't appreciate extra stress.

Big shout to Remi roofing who coordinated Sun Solar for the removal and reinstall of solar panels. Their correspondence was top notch making the experience extremely easy. Would highly recommend Remi Roofing! The Sun Solar crew was amazing! Arrived on time, extremely professional and did an incredible job with both the removal and reinstall. Both companies rated a 5+. Great job to both!!!
The job was completed the next day. They cleaned up thoroughly. Would not have known there had been work done on my property.
I had to replace my roof which was an expensive proposition, but what isn’t expensive in today’s economy!

Remi supported me throughout the process. The contractors selected for my project were very professional and efficient. They made sure my property was clean before they left each day which I appreciated very much.

We had an outstanding experience with Remi Roofing. They repaired our roof and removed/reinstalled our solar panels with exceptional service from start to finish. The team was on time, professional, courteous, and they delivered as promised. Their communication-especially the timely text updates - made the entire process smooth and stress free. I highly recommend Remi Roofing!

After a long and frustrating experience with Sunrun Solar, I have to give credit where it’s due. Their subcontractor, Remy, and his crew were outstanding. Easily some of the most professional de-installers and re-installers I’ve dealt with — punctual, respectful, knowledgeable, and incredibly easy to work with throughout the process.

Sunrun itself? Let’s just say the experience wasn’t always smooth. But the guys doing the actual work deserve recognition. Good people, true professionals, and they represented themselves with class every step of the way!

Roof had two leaks in the upper story around the skylights. The roofing company did a nice job of repair as we had 6" of rain shortly after the repair, and no water damage. The coordination of solar removal, roof repair, and reinstall solar took some patience, but in the end the job was completed and done well. Remi has the right contacts and a fair price to get the problem solved.

Our rep is Brandyn Bailey. He came prepared with our estimate before we even started chatting and was transparent about all pricing options. He was never pushy, never passive-aggressive. Just straight-forward, respectful, knowledgeable, and no unnecessary fluff. Not enough stars here!! Edit: Alicea was also very helpful withour many questions after the fact. Thanks Alicea!!

We cannot say enough good things about Remi Roofing. After our roofing project was completed, we discovered that our solar panels were no longer productive. This could have easily turned into a frustrating, drawn-out situation, but Logan, from Remi Roofing, stepped up in a way that truly exceeded our expectations.

Even though the issue involved post-construction solar performance, their team took ownership of the situation and worked diligently to make sure everything was made right. They coordinated and ensured that another technician came out to properly diagnose and repair the solar system so it could be returned to full service.

Their dedication, follow-through, and commitment to customer satisfaction were exceptional. Without their assistance and determination to see the job through, we would still be dealing with a non-productive solar system. Instead, everything is now working exactly as it should.

It’s rare these days to find a company that genuinely goes above and beyond for their customers—but Remi Roofing absolutely does. We highly recommend them and are extremely grateful for their professionalism and support from start to finish.

Mr. Harward and the rest of the Remi team were consistently professional, knowledgeable, and kept me well informed. The local roofing company Remi coordinated with (Marco, in the NY area) was also outstanding. They showed up in 20-degree weather and completed the job efficiently and professionally—an impressive level of dedication.

While my relationship with Sunrun remains on thin ice, thanks to Joshua Harward, Remi, and everyone involved in resolving my project, I feel much more confident moving forward and restoring trust in my solar provider.
Edit: After speaking with a Remi representative the issues came from the companies Remi contracted. Im pleased to say Remi made this whole situation right. Thank you.

COMPETITIVE PRICE !!! They Price Matched previous offer plus Remi’s Product was Superior Product. The Remi Crew was Very Professional though out the process. Wes Persinger the sales representative was very professional & courteous. The Installation Crew Was Excellent !!! Very Professional and Efficient !!! Their Work Was completed in TWO DAYS !!!!

Had a very good experience with Remi! There were some problems from a local company and Remi took control to get it resolved. They didn’t leave me to deal with it myself. Everyone I’ve had contact with from Remi has been kind, professional, and caring. A special shout out to Logan, who went above and beyond. That’s what you can expect from them. I highly recommend!
